subject.title: feat(plugins): upgrade llm_input/llm_output hooks from fire-and-forget to modifying

question: Should OpenClaw preserve `llm_input` and `llm_output` as observation hooks and add separate privileged interception hooks, or upgrade the existing names across every supported runner?
rationale: This is a persistent public plugin API and trust-boundary decision; the previous maintainer close explicitly left the direction unresolved.

options.title: Add separate interception hooks
options.body: Keep the shipped observation contract stable and introduce explicit modifying hooks consistently across embedded, CLI, and Codex-backed execution.

options.title: Upgrade existing hooks everywhere
options.body: Adopt in-place semantics only after all runner consumers, public docs, compatibility tests, and exact-head live proof are aligned.

options.title: Keep observation-only behavior
options.body: Decline generic model-traffic interception at this lifecycle boundary.

recommendation.title: Add separate interception hooks
recommendation.body: Keep the shipped observation contract stable and introduce explicit modifying hooks consistently across embedded, CLI, and Codex-backed execution.

likelyOwner.reason: They made the prior item-specific decision and set the acceptance bar for a replacement implementation.
